messages:
Diego: Received invoice AU-5512 from Aurora Data for $6,450. AP can't auto-match — invoice references a recurring 'platform usage surcharge' that isn't on our PO. Vendor wants net-30.
AP Bot: Invoice AU-5512 uploaded to AP queue. Status: Pending PO match.
Maya: We have PO RWD-2024-1100 for Aurora (annual subscription) but the PO covers base seats only. No surcharge line.
Olivia: Contract code `SUB-AUR-2024` shows only subscription fees. No mention of a monthly surcharge.
Aurora Billing: Hi Redwood team — surcharge was added for new analytics pipelines deployed this quarter. We can provide a detailed usage report if needed.
Diego: Can Purchasing create a change-order PO or should vendor issue corrected invoice removing the surcharge? Need to route approval before month-end.
Maya: Change-order OK if it's within existing budget bucket and approver is available. Approver on RWD-2024-1100 is Claire (finance director) who is traveling. Her proxy is @Olivia and she can approve up to $10k.
Olivia: I can approve a one-time change up to $10k but need breakdown of the usage and confirmation it's billable per agreement. @Aurora Billing please share usage detail (dates, pipelines, metric).
Aurora Billing: Sending usage CSV and invoice addendum now. We will accept credit if any line is disputed.
AP Bot: Invoice AU-5512 status updated: Pending PO match -> Awaiting vendor detail. Ticket FIN-6910 created.
Diego: Uploaded vendor CSV to ticket FIN-6910 and tagged Legal for contract interpretation.
Finance Ops: Note for month-end: if we accept surcharge and create change-order PO, record as non-recurring adjustment to subscription expense. If we dispute and vendor issues credit, adjust accruals accordingly.
Olivia: Legal flagged clause 4.2 as ambiguous 15 - asking Aurora to confirm pipeline onboarding was opted-in.
Aurora Billing: Confirmed in email: onboarding was performed under change request CR-88 approved by their Customer Success rep. Attaching CR-88.
Diego: CR-88 attached. That should validate the surcharge. Maya, do you want us to proceed with PO change-order RWD-2024-1100-CR1?
Maya: Go ahead to create PO RWD-2024-1100-CR1 and route to Olivia for approval. Marking as MEDIUM priority.
AP Bot: PO RWD-2024-1100-CR1 created and linked to invoice AU-5512. Approval requested from Olivia.
Olivia: Approved. Scheduling payment per net-30 terms. Please confirm vendor will issue any necessary corrected invoice reflecting PO change-order.
Aurora Billing: Will reissue AU-5512 referencing PO RWD-2024-1100-CR1 and send within 48 hours.
Diego: Thanks all 12 closing ticket FIN-6910 once corrected invoice attached.
